name: callisto
description: Callisto — a real-time voice AI assistant built on the Gemini Live API
author: Nelay Karmakar

scripts.build: npm run build -w @callisto/protocol && npm run build -w @callisto/server && npm run build -w @callisto/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @callisto/protocol && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @callisto/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
